bundle.method: esbuild, browser ESM, minify, NODE_ENV=production, target es2020; all non-React dependencies included

verified: native range paste2x2, staged4 cells, persisted atomically
long multiline text editor and persistence
node link opens source node in a new tab
content value persists to scenario JSON
invalid calendar date rejected and draft retained
concurrent DB change rejected and draft retained
column resize +80px, widths shared with original grid
limitations: Glide cells currently use text editors; number/date/boolean/link validated on save, specialized inputs not ported

No port of column menus, per-column filters/sort/settings UI; original grid remains available
Fixed row height40 or80 with wrap; no automatic multiline row measurement
Copying node URI returns link, not raw node ID
Drafts are in memory; switching table or reloading discards them; switching engine blocked while dirty
Conflict draft retained but no merge/rebase dialog
No mobile, assistive technology, keyboard URI activation audit or production Vite chunk delta measurement
